## What changed?

Describe the user problem and the focused change.

## How was it tested?

List the commands, browsers, devices, and manual flows tested.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated rewrites.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or real Minimal backups are included.
- [ ] JavaScript syntax checks pass.
- [ ] The manifest parses successfully.
- [ ] Local storage migration and JSON import/export still work.
- [ ] Offline behavior was considered.
- [ ] Keyboard and mobile behavior were tested.
- [ ] Privacy, security, and README documentation were updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] No external dependency was added without justification.
